description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonAccount class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButton to implement a custom display logic for a remove button in a subpanel within the SuiteCRM application. The primary functionality overrides the displayList method to conditionally display the button based on the 'EditView' setting.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonAccount
classes.description: A subclass of SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButton that customizes the display of the remove button in subpanels for Account modules, primarily checking the 'EditView' condition.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return false if 'EditView' is not set in the layout definition, otherwise calls the parent's displayList method.
